title: Italia Dance Music Radio - The Chinese

lines.l: The cherry blossoms sway, ancestors whisper, guiding our way
Oh, I'll dance to the rhythms of the east
Where tradition and heart find peace
Hear the melody of the falcons fly
In the night the moon shines bright
Tea leaf steeped in a porcelain cup
A moment shaded as we drink it up
Stories unfold in the flickering fire
Of love and loss, of dreams that aspire
Oh, dance to the rhythms of the east
Where tradition and heart find peace
Hear the melody of the falcons play
In the night the moon shines bright
The drums of the dragon echo the land
Festivals light up with lanterns so grand
With every step of the lion dance
We celebrate life giving joy a chance
Oh, dance to the rhythms of the east
Where tradition and heart find peace
Hear the melody of the falcons fly
In the night the moon shines bright
So raise your voice, let the world know
The beauty of customs, how they flow
In every heartbeat, in every song
The whispers of the East will carry us along
Italia Dance Music
Time e mezzanotte e due minuti
